name: @elizaos/os-usb-installer
description: Electrobun application for preparing bootable elizaOS USB installers.

scripts.lint: bunx @biomejs/biome check --write --unsafe src tests electrobun ../scripts/usb-installer server.ts electrobun.config.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.package:darwin: bun run verify:release-key && electrobun build --env=stable --platform darwin
scripts.package:linux: bun run verify:release-key && electrobun build --env=stable --platform linux
scripts.package:win32: bun run verify:release-key && electrobun build --env=stable --platform win32
scripts.lint:check: bunx @biomejs/biome check src tests electrobun ../scripts/usb-installer server.ts electrobun.config.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: bunx @biomejs/biome check --write --unsafe src tests electrobun ../scripts/usb-installer server.ts electrobun.config.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.format: bunx @biomejs/biome format --write src tests server.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.format:check: bunx @biomejs/biome format src tests server.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts
